indication_disease.value: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) whose disease has not progressed after first-line induction therapy
indication_disease.basis: User explicitly stated this indication wording.

stage_severity.value: Extensive-stage disease; maintenance setting - disease not progressed after 1L induction

prior_therapy_line.value: Completed first-line induction with atezolizumab + carboplatin + etoposide, without progression

therapeutic_area.basis: Indication 'small cell lung cancer' singularly and clearly belongs to Oncology.

treatment_setting_intent.value: Maintenance therapy in combination with atezolizumab

disease_subtype_histology.basis: Explicitly named in the indication wording.

therapeutic_class_mechanism.value: Selective inhibitor of oncogenic transcription (binds CG-rich DNA promoter sequences, evicts oncogenic transcription factors, stalls RNA polymerase II, leading to cell cycle arrest and apoptosis; also modulates tumour-associated macrophages)

dose.value: 3.2 mg/m^2 by IV infusion over 60 minutes

treatment_duration.value: Repeated every 21 days until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

regulatory_pathway.value: Standard marketing authorisation (not conditional); orphan medicinal product

pharmaceutical_form_strength.value: Powder for concentrate for solution for infusion

companion_diagnostic.basis: No statement provided; molecular status noted as all-comers with no biomarker selection required.

claimed_indication_wording.value: Lurbinectedin, in combination with atezolizumab, is indicated for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with ES-SCLC whose disease has not progressed after first-line induction therapy with atezolizumab, carboplatin and etoposide.
